content:
“Knock 'em out of the park!”

**Knee-Capper** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Melee weapons deal more limb damage.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Melee weapons deal +50% limb damage. (No Power Tools) | 000E36FE | 

- Before update 62, the perk provided +10%/+15%/20% damage to two-handed melee weapons and was named "Expert Slugger."
